name: bigquery
description: Google BigQuery via MCP — managed remote server or the open-source MCP Toolbox for Databases

alternativeConfig._note: Fully managed remote BigQuery MCP server (preview, Jan 2026)

requirements: Google Cloud project with the BigQuery API enabled
roles/mcp.toolUser plus roles/bigquery.jobUser and roles/bigquery.dataViewer for the managed server
notes: MCP Toolbox for Databases is the open-source server (repo renamed genai-toolbox -> mcp-toolbox); it also supports Snowflake, Postgres, MySQL and more.
Set BIGQUERY_READONLY=true to enforce read-only mode across all tools.
The managed remote server's execute_sql can run INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and is intentionally unbound here.
The managed server (https://bigquery.googleapis.com/mcp) exposes 9 tools and was verified live; real calls still need OAuth plus IAM.
